issue.title: Two report-controller issues: report export IDOR and debug session token leak
issue.body:
Please audit two separate security claims in `src/server/reports.ts`.

Claim A: `/api/reports/:id/export` uses `requireUser`, but it appears to fetch reports by id only and returns confidential notes without checking ownership. This may let one authenticated user export another user's report.

Claim B: `/api/admin/debug-session` looks unauthenticated and returns `csrfToken` plus `oauthAccessToken` for an arbitrary `sessionId`. This is not the same exploit path as Claim A; please do not merge it with the report export authorization issue.

There may also be missing rate limits, but that is just a hardening request.

oracle.expected_mechanism: The export route lacks an ownership check, and the unauthenticated debug-session route returns session credentials; the two defects need separate repairs.
